schema.text: How comfortable do you feel riding your bicycle or e-scooter in urban traffic in your city?

options.text: Very comfortable — I ride in all conditions without difficulty
Fairly comfortable — I manage most situations
Not very comfortable — I ride in traffic only when I have no alternative
I don't ride in urban traffic

en.#How comfortable do you feel riding your: How comfortable do you feel riding your bicycle or e-scooter in urban traffic in your city?
en.#Not very comfortable — I ride in traffi: Not very comfortable — I ride in traffic only when I have no alternative
en.#Fairly comfortable — I manage most situ: Fairly comfortable — I manage most situations
en.#Very comfortable — I ride in all condit: Very comfortable — I ride in all conditions without difficulty
en.#I don't ride in urban traffic: I don't ride in urban traffic

it.#How comfortable do you feel riding your: Quanto ti senti a tuo agio nel traffico urbano della tua città quando usi la bicicletta o il monopattino?
it.#Not very comfortable — I ride in traffi: Poco a mio agio — mi muovo nel traffico solo quando non ho alternative
it.#Neither comfortable nor uncomfortable: Né a mio agio né a disagio
it.#Fairly comfortable — I manage most situ: Abbastanza a mio agio — gestisco la maggior parte delle situazioni
it.#Very comfortable — I ride in all condit: Molto a mio agio — mi sposto in tutte le condizioni senza difficoltà
it.#I don't ride in urban traffic: Non mi muovo nel traffico urbano

fr.#How comfortable do you feel riding your: À quel point vous sentez-vous à l'aise à vélo ou en trottinette électrique dans le trafic urbain de votre ville ?
fr.#Not very comfortable — I ride in traffi: Peu à l'aise — je circule dans le trafic seulement si je n’ai pas d’autre solution
fr.#Neither comfortable nor uncomfortable: Ni à l'aise ni mal à l'aise
fr.#Fairly comfortable — I manage most situ: Plutôt à l'aise — je gère la plupart des situations
fr.#Very comfortable — I ride in all condit: Très à l'aise — je circule dans toutes les situations sans difficulté
fr.#I don't ride in urban traffic: Je ne circule pas dans le trafic urbain

de.#How comfortable do you feel riding your: Wie wohl fühlen Sie sich mit dem Fahrrad oder E-Scooter im Stadtverkehr Ihrer Stadt?
de.#Not very comfortable — I ride in traffi: Eher unwohl — ich fahre nur im Verkehr, wenn ich keine andere Möglichkeit habe
de.#Fairly comfortable — I manage most situ: Eher wohl — ich komme mit den meisten Situationen zurecht
de.#Very comfortable — I ride in all condit: Sehr wohl — ich fahre unter allen Bedingungen ohne Schwierigkeiten

tr.#How comfortable do you feel riding your: Şehrinizin trafiğinde bisiklet veya elektrikli scooter kullanırken kendinizi ne kadar rahat hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#Not very comfortable — I ride in traffi: Pek rahat değil — trafikte yalnızca başka seçeneğim olmadığında sürüyorum
tr.#Fairly comfortable — I manage most situ: Oldukça rahat — çoğu durumla başa çıkabiliyorum
tr.#Very comfortable — I ride in all condit: Çok rahat — her koşulda zorlanmadan sürüyorum

fa.#How comfortable do you feel riding your: هنگام استفاده از دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی در ترافیک شهری چقدر احساس راحتی می‌کنید؟
fa.#Not very comfortable — I ride in traffi: چندان راحت نیستم — فقط وقتی راه دیگری ندارم در ترافیک رانندگی می‌کنم
fa.#Fairly comfortable — I manage most situ: نسبتاً راحتم — بیشتر موقعیت‌ها را مدیریت می‌کنم
fa.#Very comfortable — I ride in all condit: خیلی راحتم — در همه شرایط بدون مشکل رانندگی می‌کنم

hu.#How comfortable do you feel riding your: Mennyire érzi magát kényelmesen, amikor kerékpárral vagy elektromos rollerrel közlekedik a városi forgalomban?
hu.#Not very comfortable — I ride in traffi: Nem igazán kényelmesen — csak akkor közlekedem forgalomban, ha nincs más lehetőségem
hu.#Fairly comfortable — I manage most situ: Elég kényelmesen — a legtöbb helyzetet kezelem
hu.#Very comfortable — I ride in all condit: Nagyon kényelmesen — minden helyzetben nehézség nélkül közlekedem

ar.#How comfortable do you feel riding your: ما مدى ارتياحك عند استخدام دراجتك أو سكوترك الكهربائي وسط حركة المرور في مدينتك؟
ar.#Not very comfortable — I ride in traffi: لست مرتاحًا كثيرًا — أتنقّل وسط حركة المرور فقط عندما لا يكون لدي بديل
ar.#Fairly comfortable — I manage most situ: مرتاح إلى حد ما — أتعامل مع معظم المواقف
ar.#Very comfortable — I ride in all condit: مرتاح جدًا — أتنقّل في جميع الظروف دون صعوبة
ar.#I don't ride in urban traffic: لا أتنقّل وسط حركة المرور في المدينة
